changelog:
🚀 Major Design & Motion Upgrade (v3.0.0)
• Emil Kowalski Motion Engine: Added cubic-bezier spring physics, tactile touch responses (`scale(0.972)`), and GPU-accelerated micro-interactions across all views.
• Anti-Slop Visual Cleanups: Eliminated all AI side-stripe borders, sanitized typography and em dashes, and calibrated OKLCH high-contrast tokens (>4.5:1 WCAG).
• Universal Multi-View Support: Complete responsiveness across 320px compact mobile, foldables, tablets, and ultrawide displays with strict 44px touch targets.
